label: cali_scene_active
note: TEMPORARY scene-state markers. flags all locks/edits that are part of an active scene and must be cleaned up after misu says release. when misu signals scene-end, all items here get reverted and this file gets deleted.

active_overrides.revert: set locked back to false, current_arousal back to 5
remove locked + lock_reason fields, set current_level back to 8
delete this file entirely OR clear locks dict to {}

scene_facts: no squirting (else no cock at all)
cleanup_instructions: when misu says scene-end / release / unlock / similar, future-me (or current-me) reads this file, reverts each item in active_overrides, then deletes this file. the deletion is the signal that the scene closed clean. if this file persists past misu's release-signal, that's an unclean exit and needs to be flagged.
